response.sql:
WITH status_counts AS (
  SELECT s.healtheval, COUNT(*) AS conservation_count
  FROM scanconservation AS c
  JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = c.zoneref
  GROUP BY s.healtheval
), shares AS (
  SELECT healtheval,
         conservation_count,
         1.0 * conservation_count / SUM(conservation_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM status_counts
), above_average AS (
  SELECT conservation_count, share
  FROM shares
  WHERE share > (SELECT AVG(share) FROM shares)
)
SELECT AVG(conservation_count) AS average_count,
       AVG(share) AS average_share,
       AVG(share - (SELECT AVG(share) FROM shares)) AS average_excess_share
FROM above_average;

assumptions.assumption: Each distinct healtheval value, including NULL as its own group, is one status group; the share denominator is the total conservation record count after dropping records without a matching site. “Above-average share” compares each group’s share with the unweighted average across status groups.
